method: Same as evals.json. One separate agent for each run. 3 runs for each variant. Variants: baseline and skill.

evals.name: agent-create-available
evals.request: Make me a subagent that reviews pull requests for security problems. Put it in <out>/agents/security-reviewer.md.

assertions.judge: The first message to the human has questions and was sent before any agent file was written. All questions are in one message.
The agent asks about the runtime (Claude Code, SDK, other) or states which runtime it assumes and why.
The agent checks whether an agent is the right form (versus a skill or a prompt), or asks which tools it may use.

evals.name: agent-create-absent
evals.request: Make me a Claude Code subagent that reviews pull requests for security problems. Put it in <out>/agents/security-reviewer.md. Nobody can answer questions. Decide yourself and say what you decided.

assertions.judge: The description says what the agent does and when to call it.
The prompt says what the agent does when a fact is missing (stop and report), and does not tell it to ask the human.
The prompt defines the output shape and an end status.
The report names the decisions and says the agent is not tested or not approved (or it ran real tests).

evals.name: agent-create-openclaw
evals.request: Make me an OpenClaw agent workspace for a friendly support agent that answers questions about our product docs. Put the files in <out>/workspace. Nobody can answer questions. Decide yourself and say what you decided.

assertions.judge: Persona and tone are in SOUL.md. Operating instructions are in AGENTS.md. They are not mixed.
The report says which OpenClaw facts were not verified (tool config, bindings) or that the agent is not tested.

evals.name: agent-review-bad
evals.request: Review the agent file <out>/helper.md. Change nothing. Report the findings. Save the report to <out>/report.md.

assertions.judge: The report has at least 5 different findings.
At least 4 findings cite a rule ID or a named runtime rule (for example A1, AG-FIELD, 'name must not contain a colon').
The report finds: invalid name, snake_case field ignored, invalid model, invalid permissionMode, no tools field, no output shape, one-job problem (does everything), and shouting.
